parameters.name: ForceStop
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to forcibly stop the instance.

*   **true**
*   **false** (default)

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance that you want to stop. You can specify only one instance ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens stop-instance --instance-id i-instanceid0000 --force-stop true --region cn-hangzhou
